advertising-campaigns.name: Ad Campaigns
advertising-campaigns.shortDescription: Analyze your ad campaign performance and make decisions based on accurate data.
advertising-campaigns.detailDescription: Connect the major digital ad platforms and track your campaign performance in one place -- conversions, return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), and cross-channel attribution -- with ready-made reports and recommendations based on your real numbers.
features: Connect ad platforms (Google, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok)
Performance analysis and return on ad spend (ROAS)
Recommendations based on your performance data

ecommerce.name: Online Stores
ecommerce.shortDescription: Connect your online store with ad and analytics systems and track your customer's full journey.
ecommerce.detailDescription: Connect your store on Salla, Zid, Shopify, or WooCommerce and track your sales, products, customers, and live visitors in one place, with precise conversion tracking via UTM and click IDs for every campaign that sends traffic.
features: Connect stores (Salla, Zid, Shopify, and more)

pos.name: Point of Sale
pos.shortDescription: A complete cashier system to manage your sales and branches with ease.
pos.detailDescription: A complete point-of-sale system that manages the cashier, inventory, invoices, shifts, and suppliers, compliant with ZATCA's e-invoicing requirements, and designed to manage one branch or several from a single place.

madar-apps-reports.name: Reports
madar-apps-reports.shortDescription: Ready-made reports and comprehensive analytics for your business performance in one place.
madar-apps-reports.detailDescription: Track your business performance through ready-made and custom reports that bring together your data from every active Madar app -- sales, campaigns, store, and POS -- with export and recurring scheduling.
features: Ready-made reports for every active app

madar-apps-expenses.name: Expenses
madar-apps-expenses.shortDescription: Track and categorize your business expenses easily in one place.
madar-apps-expenses.detailDescription: Record your operating expenses and categorize them by category or branch, and continuously track your business's cash flow with ready-made expense reports to help you make better financial decisions.
features: Link expenses to branches and categories

madar-apps-tasks.name: Tasks
madar-apps-tasks.shortDescription: Organize your team's tasks and track their completion as it happens.
madar-apps-tasks.detailDescription: Create tasks for your team, set priorities and deadlines, and track the completion status of every task from a single board that brings together everything your team needs to focus on.
features: Create tasks and assign them to the team
Track completion status in real time

madar-apps-accounting.name: Accounting
madar-apps-accounting.shortDescription: Manage your finances and invoices in one place.
madar-apps-accounting.detailDescription: Track accounting entries, invoices, suppliers, and customers, and issue your periodic financial reports -- profit and loss, and the balance sheet -- in compliance with ZATCA's requirements.

madar-apps-documents.name: Documents
madar-apps-documents.shortDescription: Store and organize your business documents in one secure place.
madar-apps-documents.detailDescription: Upload your important business documents -- contracts, invoices, and licenses -- and organize them into folders, with the ability to access and share them securely at any time.
features: Upload documents and organize them into folders
